title: Coast Guard medevacs man from cargo ship 100 miles off Kauai
credit: U.S. Coast Guard video by Chief Petty Officer Corinne Zilnicki and Petty Officer 2nd Class Tyler Robertson
description: An MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew assigned to Coast Guard Air Station Barbers Point in Kapolei, Hawaii, takes on fuel aboard medium endurance cutter USCGC Harriet Lane (WMEC 903) before conducting a medevac approximately 100 miles offshore Kauai March 3, 2026. The aircrew hoisted a 37-year-old man experiencing severe abdominal pain from the 547-foot roll-on/roll-off cargo ship Viking Emerald. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Chief Petty Officer Corinne Zilnicki and Petty Officer 2nd Class Tyler Robertson)
